headline: Mechanistic models calibrated against tree-level, serological, and dynamical data
label: Data Constrained Mechanistic Modeling
summary: Structured outputs such as transmission trees, paired serology, and dynamical simulations are now tested directly against data, often with accompanying…
synthesis: The dominant thread is direct testing and calibration of mechanistic models against structured outputs rather than summary statistics alone. Transmission-tree ensembles are compared with chi-square and PERMANOVA tests, with PERMANOVA reported as more sensitive, and the comparison is packaged as the mixtree R package. Likelihood-free methods calibrate dynamical models: ABC-SMC is presented as a PyMC tutorial for ecological and epidemiological systems, and Neural Posterior Estimation is evaluated for Ebola epidemiological and phylodynamic models. A Bayesian mixture model jointly interprets paired dengue serological assays and is reported to outperform cut-point methods. A separate wastewater study applies semi-supervised deep learning to estimate COVID-19 case counts from viral RNA. What is new is treating tree-level, serological, and dynamical outputs as objects tested or calibrated directly against data, with software or tutorials accompanying several studies.
